source_text:
domain are-route-availability "ARE registered route availability"
profile declarative-function-v1
owner agent-reasoning-engine-runtime-owner
logic sfol-v1

schema RouteAvailabilityFacts:
  registry_declared: boolean
  lifecycle_available: boolean
  capability_required: boolean
  capability_available: boolean
  route_identity_matches: boolean

schema RouteAvailabilityDecision:
  status: string pattern "^(available|unavailable)$"
  repair_focus: string pattern "^(registry|lifecycle|module-capability|route-identity|none)$"
  authority_effect: string const "none"

mapping RegistryUnavailable:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-REGISTRY-UNAVAILABLE"
  meaning "A module cannot introduce a route that the verified route registry does not declare."
  target RouteAvailabilityDecision
  field status = "unavailable"
  field repair_focus = "registry"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping LifecycleUnavailable:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-LIFECYCLE-UNAVAILABLE"
  meaning "A registered route with a blocked lifecycle remains unavailable regardless of module presence."
  target RouteAvailabilityDecision
  field status = "unavailable"
  field repair_focus = "lifecycle"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping CapabilityUnavailable:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-CAPABILITY-UNAVAILABLE"
  meaning "A module-bound route is unavailable when its exact declared capability cannot answer."
  target RouteAvailabilityDecision
  field status = "unavailable"
  field repair_focus = "module-capability"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping IdentityUnavailable:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-IDENTITY-UNAVAILABLE"
  meaning "A module response for a different route cannot satisfy the declared route binding."
  target RouteAvailabilityDecision
  field status = "unavailable"
  field repair_focus = "route-identity"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping RouteAvailable:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-AVAILABLE"
  meaning "The registered route is lifecycle-available and any declared module capability answered for the same route."
  target RouteAvailabilityDecision
  field status = "available"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

rule RegistryIsMissing:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-REGISTRY-MISSING"
  meaning "Registry declaration precedes every module availability claim."
  condition input.registry_declared == false

rule LifecycleIsBlocked:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-LIFECYCLE-BLOCKED"
  meaning "Registry lifecycle blocking cannot be overridden by a module."
  condition input.registry_declared and input.lifecycle_available == false

rule RequiredCapabilityIsMissing:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-REQUIRED-CAPABILITY-MISSING"
  meaning "An explicitly module-bound route requires an available capability receipt."
  condition input.registry_declared and input.lifecycle_available and input.capability_required and input.capability_available == false

rule RouteIdentityDiffers:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-IDENTITY-DIFFERS"
  meaning "The available capability result must name the exact registered route."
  condition input.registry_declared and input.lifecycle_available and input.capability_required and input.capability_available and input.route_identity_matches == false

rule RegistryRouteIsAvailable:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-REGISTRY-ROUTE-AVAILABLE"
  meaning "A route without a module binding uses only its declared registry lifecycle."
  condition input.registry_declared and input.lifecycle_available and input.capability_required == false

rule ModuleRouteIsAvailable:
  ontology "ARE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY-MODULE-ROUTE-AVAILABLE"
  meaning "A module-bound route is available only after an exact matching capability response."
  condition input.registry_declared and input.lifecycle_available and input.capability_required and input.capability_available and input.route_identity_matches

result EvaluateRouteAvailability:
  ontology "ARE-EVALUATE-ROUTE-AVAILABILITY"
  meaning "Evaluate availability only; do not select the route, run its adapter, or enforce its workflow."
  when RegistryIsMissing yield RegistryUnavailable
  when LifecycleIsBlocked yield LifecycleUnavailable
  when RequiredCapabilityIsMissing yield CapabilityUnavailable
  when RouteIdentityDiffers yield IdentityUnavailable
  when RegistryRouteIsAvailable yield RouteAvailable
  when ModuleRouteIsAvailable yield RouteAvailable

endpoint RouteAvailability:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/are/route-availability"
  input RouteAvailabilityFacts
  output RouteAvailabilityDecision
  result EvaluateRouteAvailability
  auth-env ARE_RUNTIME_TOKEN
  max-bytes 8192
  timeout-ms 1000
  error-status 422
  status unavailable 409
  status available 200
